build_NeRF_raymarcher: build a NeRF raymarcher that renders features from ray densities and returns emission-absorption weights
create_EmissionAbsorptionNeRFRaymarcher: create an EmissionAbsorptionNeRFRaymarcher instance to perform volume rendering with importance sampling support
